deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2027-01-06.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Wednesday 6 January 2027

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or be predicted to achieve a first-class undergraduate degree with honours in mathematics or a related discipline; a previous master's degree is not required.
entry_route.quote: a first-class undergraduate degree with honours in mathematics or a related discipline. A previous master's degree is not required

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need to contact the department or secure agreement from an academic before applying.
supervisor.quote: you do not need to contact the department before you apply

funding.value: All eligible applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Oxford scholarships.
funding.quote: Final application deadline to be considered for Oxford scholarships

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test is not stated or required for DPhil in Mathematics at Oxford.

notes: DPhil in Mathematics at the University of Oxford.
